card.line: Marah was a place in the desert where Israel found bitter water after crossing the Red Sea, and where the LORD sweetened it and spoke of healing.

moments.title: Bitter water
moments.text: After walking three days in the desert without finding water, Israel came to Marah. They could not drink the water because it was bitter, so the people grumbled against Moses.

moments.title: The LORD sweetens the water
moments.text: Moses cried out to the LORD, and He showed him a log. When Moses threw it into the water, the water became sweet.

moments.title: A test and a promise
moments.text: At Marah the LORD tested Israel. He told them that if they listened to Him and obeyed, He would not bring on them the diseases of Egypt, for He is the LORD who heals them.
